requirements.text: Personalised timetable management must include features for colour-coding modules, hiding cancelled classes, and adding personal study blocks.
Automated grade notifications must alert students when new grades are posted in a timely manner.
Module feedback system must allow students to submit structured feedback after the teaching period, focusing on content quality and delivery, while ensuring anonymity for responses.
All new features must maintain the stability of the current portal.
Any new additions must integrate well with the existing system without introducing unnecessary complexity.
